MilkyLib

Simple, lightweight library created by glackus for Worldofmilk (25w14milk), and other projects created by glackus or LighSync Games

📦 Installation

1. Install **Minecraft Forge** for the supported version. 2. Open your `.minecraft` folder. 3. Create a `mods` folder if it doesn't exist. 4. Place the mod `.jar` file inside the `mods` folder. 5. Launch the game with Forge. --- ## 🐞 Bug Reporting I found a bug! What should I do? Don't worry! You can report the bug on our [GitHub](https://github.com/LighSync/issues) or [Discord server](https://discord.gg/KYyAuYssvT) --- ## ❤️ Credits Created by **LighSync Games** Authors: - Gleb Ustimenko (nogai3, glackus) - Developer.
